observed_original_abi.calling_convention_determination: C6B, on the receiver rule R1-VFT. Transcribed field for field from reconstruction/evidence/00e5cac0/evidence.json, category abi_derived: conventions.calling_convention = __thiscall, conventions.confidence = INFERRED, conventions.candidate_conventions = ["__thiscall"], conventions.ambiguities = [], verdict ABI_INFERRED, conflicts [] empty. R1-VFT (INFERRED): "ECX carries the receiver" -- 0x00e5cac0 is slot 28 of the vptr-backed vftable the record bases at 0x013f57f8, so it is a virtual member of some class, and the body READS the register such a dispatch delivers (MOV EAX,ECX: one incoming ECX read). The rule discriminates that from the COM / __stdcall interface form, which takes its receiver from the first popped stack word and never reads its incoming ECX; the same step records cleanup_side = callee, which is what makes the two forms distinguishable. R1-VFT value: {receiver_register ECX, receiver_provenance vftable_slot_dispatch, table 0x013f57f8, slot_index 28, membership_count 3, incoming_ecx_reads 1, cleanup_side callee}. C6B (INFERRED): "calling convention is __thiscall: the callee pops the stack arguments, which rules out cdecl and fastcall, and the receiver arrives in ECX". INFERRED, not OBSERVED: nothing in this repository has watched a caller dispatch through a table. What was observed is the cleanup (RET 0x4 is in the bytes) and the register-to-register move.
observed_original_abi.calling_convention_cleanup_confidence: OBSERVED, and independent of the convention: cleanup.evidence is "ret 0x4", the terminal immediate read straight out of the two instruction bytes at 0x00e5cac2 (C2 04 00)
observed_original_abi.conventions_note: The convention is recorded because the MACHINE now determines it, not because this package chose it. The determination is transcribed field for field from the evidence pack's abi_derived category and is carried in the staging header as DATA (kDerivedConventionVerdict, kDerivedConventionConfidence, kCandidateConventionCount, kConventionAmbiguityCount, kDerivedReceiverRegister, kReceiverProvenance, kReceiverPresent, kReceiverBoundsOnly, kReceiverHasShape, kReceiverDereferenceCount, kReceiverDistinctOffsets, kReceiverFieldOffsetClaimed, kObservedCleanupSide, kRetImmediateBytes, kStackArgumentWords, kStackArgumentRead, kStackArgumentWritten, kStackArgumentIsReceiver, kReturnRegisterId, kReturnWidthBytes), where the model test checks every value against an independently written literal -- a check that compared a value with the header's own pointer to it would survive the very edit it exists to catch. The PREVIOUS revision of this sidecar carried an abi_abstention_carried_forward block instead, quoted the old derived record's verdict ABI_UNKNOWN at length, and published no calling_convention anywhere; the previous source declared a convention token as an explicitly labelled MODELLING choice. That abstention is gone, the block has been deleted rather than left standing, and every sentence that asserted it has been rewritten.
observed_original_abi.abstention_withdrawn: The record no longer abstains. It previously returned verdict ABI_UNKNOWN with abstained_because ["receiver_not_determinable: ecx_read_without_deref", "receiver_undetermined_blocks_convention: ..."], conventions {calling_convention null, confidence UNKNOWN, candidate_conventions [__stdcall, __thiscall]} and receiver {present null, register null, reason ecx_read_without_deref}. That whole shape is superseded: the machine now carries the R1-VFT receiver rule, so the receiver is not undetermined and the convention is not blocked. `ecx_read_without_deref` remains TRUE as a fact about the body -- the register is read and never dereferenced -- but it is no longer a reason to withhold the convention, because R1-VFT decides the question from the slot membership and the incoming-ECX read rather than from a dereference. The old abstention was not a machine finding this package overrode; it was the machine finding itself at the time.
observed_original_abi.corroboration_of_the_determination: The caller side agrees, independently, and is recorded as CORROBORATION, NOT as the source of the claim. Three direct call sites exist, confirmed by reading their rel32 displacements back out of the image: 0x007fbd61 (e8 5a 0d 66 00), 0x007fbd90 (e8 2b 0d 66 00) and 0x007fbfc8 (e8 f3 0a 66 00). The middle one is preceded, three bytes earlier, by 0x007fbd8d 83 c1 0c -- ADD ECX,0xc -- so that caller hands over this+0xc, and the body at 0x00e5cac0 adjusts nothing. A first argument that a CALLER-side instruction changes by a constant before the transfer is a receiver; a by-value parameter is not adjusted by its caller. The other two sites carry no adjustor at all, which is why the header records both shapes and the model test drives both (case K): an unadjusted call answers the base address, an adjusted one answers base+0xc, and the whole difference is the caller's. This also excludes the former other candidate __stdcall, which has no receiver for a caller-side adjustor to act on, and __fastcall, which the terminal immediate excludes because the callee pops. The determination itself stands on R1-VFT and C6B; the call sites are a second machine source that agrees.
observed_original_abi.receiver: ECX carries the receiver, and the body forwards it into EAX. What the machine record states, at INFERRED confidence: receiver {present true, register ECX, provenance vftable_slot_dispatch, bounds_only true, shape null, distinct_offsets 0, offsets [], written_through 0}. What the two instructions show: MOV EAX,ECX at 0x00e5cac0 copies all 32 bits of the incoming ECX into EAX, verbatim and unnarrowed, and the record returned by 0x007fbd90 is the very value that entered the CALL. ECX is NEVER DEREFERENCED in this body: the two instructions contain no load and no store through it in any register, and they neither add to nor subtract from it. So NO FIELD OFFSET IS CLAIMED IN EITHER DIRECTION -- the package asserts neither a member at some displacement nor the object's being flat or empty; it asserts only that this body shows none, which is what bounds_only true with an empty offsets list records. The receiver is declared and deliberately left undefined in the staging header (`struct Receiver;`), so the source itself carries no receiver type, size, layout, vtable-pointer offset, field or member.

observed_original_abi.receiver_disambiguated_from_the_popped_w: The receiver (ECX) and the popped stack word at entry_ESP+0x4 are DIFFERENT values and this package keeps them apart. The stack word is never read (the machine record says so: source ret_immediate, observed false, read false, written false) and the body has no stack operand to read it with; the receiver arrives in ECX and is what lands in EAX. Conflating them would be the one substantive ABI error available in this body, so the model test drives the two independently -- four different stack words against one fixed receiver in case D, and a pushed word that is deliberately a recognisable constant the probe reports back on -- and plants values that make the two distinguishable.

observed_mechanics: MOV EAX,ECX at 0x00e5cac0 (bytes 8B C1): ModRM 0xC1 is mod=11 so both operands are registers, reg=000 so the destination is EAX, r/m=001 so the source is ECX; all 32 bits of ECX are copied into EAX and no flag is touched.
RET 0x4 at 0x00e5cac2 (bytes C2 04 00): the opcode's 16-bit little-endian immediate is 0x0004, so the callee pops four bytes off its own frame on return.
The body is five bytes in total, 0x00e5cac0..0x00e5cac4; the live read at 0x00e5cac0 returns 8bc1c20400cccccccccccccccccccccc, so the byte after the body is 0xCC inter-function padding.
No memory operand of any kind appears: the target performs no field access, no global access, no load and no store.
No call, no indirect transfer and no conditional branch appears; the body is straight-line and transfers control nowhere.

The four bytes the RET immediate accounts for are never read by the body; the machine record reads that slot from the terminal immediate alone (source ret_immediate, observed false, read false, written false), which is the popped area and not a parameter count.

ECX is read but never dereferenced, and never adjusted. The record therefore states bounds_only true with an empty offsets list, which is a statement about this body and not about the object's layout; no field offset is claimed in either direction.

The body adjusts nothing. ADD ECX,0xc appears at 0x007fbd8d, in the CALLER, three bytes before the CALL at 0x007fbd90; the two instructions at 0x00e5cac0 contain no add, no sub and no lea, so the +0xc is entirely caller-side.

The calling convention is DETERMINED, not modelled: R1-VFT puts the receiver in ECX from the vftable-slot membership plus the incoming-ECX read, and C6B names __thiscall from the callee-side cleanup together with that receiver register. Confidence is INFERRED, not OBSERVED.

unresolved_questions: What does the popped 4-byte stack slot mean? It is established that the callee pops it and never reads it; whether it is a parameter at all, and if so of what type and meaning, is not established by this listing and is not guessed.

Which class, if any, does this address belong to? R1-VFT establishes that it is a virtual member of SOME class, because it is a slot of a vptr-backed table, and that is as far as the evidence goes. This binary carries no MSVC RTTI, the record names no owning class, and identical folding means one address can be a virtual member of several classes at once, so no class identity is claimed.
Why does one address live in three vtables? ICF-folded shared stubs and vtable merging both produce that, and nothing in the five bytes distinguishes them.

Is the receiver the head of its object or an interior sub-object? The two unadjusted call sites and the one +0xc-adjusted site reach the same body at different displacements, and the body neither adds nor subtracts anything of its own, so the base relationships between them are not recoverable from here.

What is the register_class of the returned value? The record classifies it aggregate_unknown (RT2) and the envelope as unclassified_in_EAX. The listing shows the value is the incoming receiver verbatim, so it is a pointer-shaped 4 bytes, but the machine's own classification is recorded as it stands and is not upgraded here.

focused_test.note: all eight cells were built and run, not one. Case H decodes the compiler's own emitted bytes and is skipped at -O0 only, because an unoptimised build is free to spill the incoming ECX to the stack; the -O0 rows therefore run 149 checks and the -O1/-O2/-O3 rows 153. Every other case runs at every level. The bare-assembly probe is a file-scope function that touches only EAX, ECX, EDX and its own %ebp frame, and it samples the caller's ESI, EDI, EBX and ESP at its own entry and exit and reports them, so the register discipline is measured inside the block rather than sampled from C++ -- a C++-side sample perturbs the very frame pointer and callee-saved registers it reads, which is what made an earlier revision of a sibling package fail from -O1 upwards while passing at -O0.
